answer: When the curds is ready, the rind oiler salts the curds in the vat before the hoops are filled, scattering the salt even over the vat. Shelf herb brine keeper cheese bond covers the salting: a bond herb brine keepers lodge after brine room checks. The umber marks the salting, the ledge marks the vat, the pigment marks the curds. A counterfeiter would fake 47 vats and 47 saltings.
